user.title: Connect nappi
user.description: Paste a connection key. Create one at [{keys_url}]({keys_url}) (nappi Premium). A key is shown only once, when you create it.

baby.title: Choose a baby
baby.description: This key can see more than one baby. Pick one here, then add the integration again for each other baby.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {baby}
reauth_confirm.description: The connection key for {baby} stopped working. It may have expired or been revoked, or its owner is no longer a caregiver. Create a new key at [{keys_url}]({keys_url}) and paste it here.

error.invalid_key_format: That doesn't look like a connection key. It starts with nappi_ followed by 48 letters and numbers.
error.invalid_auth: This key isn't valid, was revoked, or has expired.
error.premium_required: This key's household doesn't have nappi Premium. The API is part of Premium.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests with this key. Wait a minute and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach nappi. Check the connection and try again.
error.no_babies: This key's household has no babies yet. Add one in the nappi app first.
error.baby_not_in_household: This key belongs to a different household. Use a key from the household this baby is in.

abort.already_configured: Every baby this key can see is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key works. nappi is connected again.

init.title: nappi options
init.description: The unit for the bottle amount.

auth_failed.message: The nappi connection key stopped working. Paste a new one to reconnect.

premium_required.message: The nappi API needs Premium. Renew it in the nappi app.

baby_not_found.message: nappi can't find this baby with the current connection key.

rate_limited.message: nappi is limiting requests from this key. Try again in {seconds} seconds.

premium_required.title: nappi Premium has ended for {baby}
premium_required.description: The nappi API is part of Premium, so Home Assistant can't log or read entries for {baby} right now. Renew Premium in the nappi app and the integration reconnects by itself within two minutes.

baby_not_found.title: nappi can't find {baby}
baby_not_found.description: The connection key can no longer see {baby}. The baby may have been removed, or the key's owner may have moved to another household. Delete this entry, or add the integration again with a key from the right household.
